name: Rowan Phipps
biography: Rowan is an undergraduate at the University of Washington where he studies Computer Science. He's a member of Batman's Kitchen and has participated in CTF and CCDC competitions. Last summer he worked in the Digital Financial Services Research Group looking into the security of mobile money. In his spare time he likes to dabble with hardware design. @RowanPhipps
